from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """Represents one provided paper extracted from a document."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The title of the current paper")
    references: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of other provided papers that this paper references (outgoing relationships)")
    citations: list[str] = Field(default=[], description="Titles of other provided papers that cite this paper (incoming relationships); populated by inference agent")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    papers: list[Paper] = Field(description="List of all provided papers extracted from the document collection")
